title: Step 2 - Create A New Pattern
section: 20. Boss Level Challenge 2 - The Simon Game
summary: Generate a random colour and append it to the game's pattern array.

concepts.heading: Data structures
points: buttonColours is a global array holding red, blue, green, yellow in a fixed order; index 0-3 maps to a colour.
gamePattern is a global empty array that grows by one colour per level.

concepts.heading: Random number
points: Math.random() returns a float in [0,1) and never 1. Multiply by 4 and wrap in Math.floor() to get an integer 0-3.
Use the console to sanity check the range.

concepts.heading: Picking and storing
points: gamePattern.push(randomChosenColour) adds it to the end.
